description: Exact lexical scope (docs/rules.md, Attribution): a `def skipTest` inside `if True:` in the body of the test's class binds the name `skipTest` in the class scope, so `self.skipTest` is that binding, not unittest.TestCase's. TG003 warns that `self.skipTest()` may skip `TestA::test_adds`, never FAIL, never silence. The real runner runs the test.
